name: mirage
text: Yes, v1.0.107 is built and out. Fix: each NCAAB Bet button now picks its side by the team name the side carries, so the button next to the home team opens the home team's slip, even when ESPN and Novig list home/away in opposite order. https://github.com/tjshea90/novig/releases/tag/v1.0.107 . Please check the moneyline buttons on a few games and tell me if any still open the wrong team.
